scope: Real standard-library command wrapper fidelity attacks, not application completion

scope.childCpu: Waited command children/descendants; excludes independently started web server and database
scope.sandboxCpu: Whole readable Linux cgroup; includes server/database and any concurrent sandbox work; not command-exclusive
scope.memory: Largest waited-child high-water RSS on Linux; NOT summed or simultaneous process-tree peak
scope.fidelity: No scheduling, assertion, workload or return-code substitution; all stdout/stderr retained in log
